'''''Vinca difformis''''', commonly called the '''intermediate periwinkle''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is an evergreen, flowering [[subshrub]].

It grows to about {{Convert|0.5|m|ft|frac=2}} tall, and forms mats over {{Convert|1|m|ft|abbr=on|frac=2}} across. Its whitish-blue flowers have a blooming season from late winter to early spring.

It is native to Western Europe, including the [[Iberian Peninsula]], [[France]], the [[Italian Peninsula]] and [[Sardinia]].
